item: {"addr": "0x1407434fe", "comment": "Exterior: a different worldspace or more than 4096 units (one cell) away loads the destination's location and cell; a closer target in the same worldspace skips the load (v74 'near' flag) but is still carried out below and still sends PositionPlayerEvent (read 2026-11-09, /tpa)"}

{"addr": "0x1407435a7", "comment": "Interior: a target in the player's own parentCell (+0x60) skips the location change but is still carried out (sub_40744) and reported as an arrival, so a MoveTo inside the cell is a travel too (read 2026-11-09, /tpa)"}

{"addr": "0x140a5d4fb", "comment": "The player: no same-cell check, every MoveTo builds a PLAYER_TARGET_LOC (world a4 at +0, interior a3 at +8, position +0x10, angle z +0x24, furniture handle +0x38, resetWeather +0x40=1, allowAutoSave/valid +0x41) and queues it (40442); 40438 carries it out next frame (read on 1.7.104 2026-11-09)"}
